letter.title: To My Nikki ❤️
paragraphs: If there's one thing I want you to always be sure of, it's how much you mean to me.
I know life won't always be perfect. There will be beautiful days when everything feels easy, and there will be difficult days when things don't go as planned.
But I want you to know something.
I don't choose you only on the happy days. I choose you on the difficult ones, too.

When we're laughing together, I choose you. When we're tired, worried, or struggling to find the right words, I choose you. When life changes around us and the future feels uncertain, I'll still choose you.
I promise to keep showing up for us, to listen, to learn, to grow, and to never stop putting my heart into the life we're building together.
Through every high and low, through all the thick and thin, whatever tomorrow brings, I want to face it with you.
And if life gave me the chance to make this decision a thousand times over, my answer would still be the same.
I love you more than these words could ever explain.
And no matter what, I'll always choose you.
